column1: # Format: <rule id><TAB><IGNORE|WARN|FAIL><TAB><reason, free text>.  Keep every IGNORE justified; default (unlisted) is WARN.
# Escalate what we fixed so a regression fails the run:

column3: Anti-clickjacking header (X-Frame-Options / frame-ancestors) must stay set
CSP: wildcard / unsafe directives must not creep in
Authenticated/API responses must not be cacheable (Cache-Control: no-store)
Storable/cacheable content on the SPA: hashed /assets/* are intentionally immutable-cacheable; index.html is no-cache and the app shell holds no user data
Timestamp disclosure: the API returns ISO timestamps (createdAt etc.) by design
Suspicious comments: minified third-party bundles contain words like "TODO"/"select" (no secrets; gitleaks covers source)
Site isolation (Spectre): COOP/CORP are already set; the remaining sub-checks are about cross-origin resource policy of the SPA that loads Google Fonts on purpose
Cross-domain misconfiguration: Access-Control-Allow-Origin is reflected only for origins in CORS_ORIGINS (verified with a disallowed Origin in docs/SECURITY_SCANNING.md)
